scientific_question: Can one compact shared linear set operator approximate the dense v185 detector-potential affine inverse from deployment-visible observation and reported geometry while preserving camera-permutation invariance and five/nine-camera matched accuracy after at most one unchanged physical CGLS step?
role: post-open compact-predictor mechanism diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames used by v179-v185; it is not the final complete-trajectory gate, resource benchmark, fresh generalization, or real BOST
physical_hypothesis: A detector potential is a camera-local scalar field while an oriented reported ray is represented by its world direction and Plucker line moment. Pooling low-frequency potential coefficients against those line descriptors should preserve enough of the geometry-conditioned inverse action for one shared fit-only linear map to recover the affine warm state without constructing the 1009-column potential response at deployment.
physical_distinction: v186 does not retune the failed v184 scalar-ray lift, v185 dense pseudoinverse, detector integration, physical K1, camera subset, or accuracy gate. It replaces the per-setup dense 1009-column inverse with one shared permutation-invariant observation/geometry feature map and one fit-only closed-form linear map.

data_isolation.fit_source: exactly inherit the ten already-open PoolFire fit trajectories, 7400 fit fields, affine center, 1009-row orthonormal basis, thirteen calibration files, and frozen five-camera subsets from v178-v185
fit_truth_allowed_only_for: constructing the inherited affine center and basis
fit-only affine target coordinates and their covariance
closed-form shared linear weights before heldout fields are loaded
data_isolation.heldout_source: exactly p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 already opened through v179-v185
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: DCT side, mode roster, geometry descriptors, feature normalization, active feature roster, eig threshold, weights, controls, fallback, stopping, and decision
any fit statistic, model parameter, feature transform, or candidate field
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observation generation through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after the observation-only prediction barrier

primary_feature_map.name: potential_dct12_reported_ray_plucker_set
primary_feature_map.potential: exactly inherit v185 zero-mean detector-potential integration and valid 24x24 reported-geometry ray masks
primary_feature_map.invalid_detector_nodes: zero fill before the orthonormal DCT
primary_feature_map.dct: per camera scipy.fft.dctn type-II norm=ortho; retain the lexicographic 12x12 low-frequency square and remove only the DC coefficient
primary_feature_map.dct_side_derivation: 12 is the smallest integer q for which 8*(q*q-1) is at least the inherited 1009 affine rank; q is not searched
primary_feature_map.active_ray_direction: normalize every active world-frame ray direction, average equally within a camera, then normalize the mean; tie or zero norm is invalid
primary_feature_map.pooling: sum the outer product of each camera's 143 DCT coefficients and its eight reported-ray descriptor values
primary_feature_map.flatten_order: DCT mode major, camera-descriptor minor, C order

fit_only_closed_form.fit_coordinate: Z=(fit_field-center) basis^T; the inherited orthonormal affine reconstruction must reproduce every fit field within 1e-10 relative error
fit_only_closed_form.geometry_response_feature: for each of the 26 frozen calibration/sensor setups, Q is the primary feature map applied column-wise to the v185 potential response B, so fit features equal Z Q without heldout data
fit_only_closed_form.normalization: scale_j=sqrt(S_jj/(26*7400)); features with exactly zero finite scale are inactive and all others use their unmodified positive scale
fit_only_closed_form.solver: symmetric float64 eigendecomposition of the standardized covariance; retain eigenvalues at least lambda_max*sqrt(float64 epsilon)
fit_only_closed_form.intercept: none; the inherited fit coordinates must have maximum absolute mean at most 1e-10

blocking_controls.geometry_blind_dct12_linear: repeat the identical fit-only closed-form solve using only descriptor channels [1,1/active_camera_count], for 286 raw features
blocking_controls.potential_coordinate_cgls1: inherit the v185 one-direction potential-coordinate CGLS1 K0/K1 control without retuning
blocking_controls.fit_mean: inherit the frozen affine center at K0/K1
blocking_controls.dense_v185_reference: report the independently validated v185 dense K0/K1 result only as an upper reference; it cannot count as a compact control

evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual and denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened

cost_ledger.shared_model_training: offline fit-only; 26 dense potential response transforms are inherited in role but rebuilt and fully disclosed
cost_ledger.resource_claim: none before matched accuracy, complete-trajectory scoring, fresh-process wall, and whole-pipeline RSS

required_validity_gates: v185 protocol, repairs, formal, independent validation, decision, recursive parent closure, source closure, and input trees remain unchanged
the model is fully fitted and sealed before heldout fields are loaded
the prediction API accepts no truth, trajectory, time, power, or size input
fit affine reconstruction, zero target mean, covariance symmetry, positive feature scales, eig stationarity, and finite weights pass the fixed tolerances
formal raw feature count is 1144 and geometry-blind raw feature count is 286 with no post-result feature deletion except exactly zero-scale columns
camera permutation changes primary and control features, coordinates, and fields by at most 1e-10
fixed-observation truth mutation leaves features, coordinates, and candidates byte-identical
five and nine cameras are both processed by the same primary weight matrix
prediction, physical K1, metric, and exact-call arrays are finite and match the frozen shapes
formal and input trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: ten fit trajectories, affine center/basis/coordinates/covariance, thirteen calibrations, five-camera selections, vector and scalar operators
zero-filled detector grids, DCT-II modes, active-ray means, normalized centers, Plucker moments, primary and geometry-blind features
closed-form covariance, normalization, eig inverse, shared weights, heldout predictions, unchanged K1, metrics, tails, decisions, and cost receipts

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, parent, fit, feature, covariance, eig, normalization, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v186 inconclusive.
If the primary K0 passes both sensor arms, use K0 for the control comparison; otherwise use K1 only if K1 passes both sensor arms.

If neither primary K0 nor primary K1 passes both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_SET_LINEAR_V186 and close the current DCT12 plus reported-ray Plucker shared-linear representation without enlarging it.

If the matching geometry-blind, potential-coordinate CGLS1, or fit-mean control also passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_COMPACT_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V186 and do not claim a geometry-conditioned advantage.

Only if the selected primary passes both arms and every blocking control fails, conclude PASS_POTENTIAL_SET_LINEAR_HEADROOM_V186 and authorize a separately frozen complete-p22-trajectory gate with Zero/BP/CGLS/PCGLS/dual-ridge fairness controls.
No v186 outcome is exact-call reduction, wall/RSS benefit, fresh generalization, neural-operator advantage, curved-ray validation, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
